text: Incident response for data pipelines — the five stages every real incident actually moves through.
Detect, triage, mitigate, resolve, review. Naming these explicitly is what keeps a stressed team from skipping one — most commonly, mitigation.
Mitigation stops the bleeding right now, even imperfectly — pausing a spamming alert, rerouting around a broken piece. Resolution is the real fix, which takes much longer to find and verify safely.

Someone also needs to be actively communicating what's happening — separate work from the technical fix, often assigned to a different person. And the incident isn't over until resolution actually lands and verification confirms it. Next up: root cause analysis, step by step — what resolution actually requires finding.
